messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up: OrionBank returned the SIG v2 and flagged Q21-Q24 as blockers. They want per-question artifacts + 1-2 sentence plain-English answers. Can we split and turn around by Wednesday?

mira_se: I can do Q21 (tenant isolation) and Q24 (network segmentation). Need the redacted tenancy diagram and an Envoy YAML snippet.

josh_security: I'll take Q22 (KMS/key rotation) and Q23 (encryption at rest/in-transit). I have a short rotation excerpt and an encryption practices note.

nadia_ps: I'll pull SOC2 excerpt, the dataflow narrative, and a small POC screenshot showing tenant filters.

uploaderbot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/tenancy_diagram_orionbank.pdf|tenancy_diagram_orionbank.pdf> (420KB)

mira_se: Drafting a sanitized Envoy snippet (will redact hostnames before upload):
```yaml
# sanitized per-tenant routing example
virtual_hosts:
  - name: tenant-orion
    routes:
      - match: /tenant/orion/*
        cluster: rwinf-tenant-orion
```

josh_security: For KMS, reference HSM-backed provider and rotation cadence. I'll attach `kms_rotation_brief.md` and `encryption_summary.txt`. Note BYOK supported for Private deployments via KMS APIs.

nadia_ps: Uploaded SOC2 excerpt and dataflow narrative: <https://files.redwood.internal/soc2_orionbank_excerpt.pdf|soc2_orionbank_excerpt.pdf>, <https://files.redwood.internal/dataflow_orionbank.md|dataflow_orionbank.md>

alex_sales: Please paste final shared filenames for the bundle and a 1-2 sentence plain-English blurb per question so I can paste into the SIG answers.

mira_se: Filenames: `/shared/sales-orionbank/tenancy_diagram_redacted.pdf`, `/shared/sales-orionbank/envoy_tenant_snippet.yaml`
mira_se: Plain English (Q21/Q24): "Tenant requests are routed with tenant-specific proxy rules that map to isolated runtime clusters and separate network segments; proxy and network policies prevent cross-tenant traffic."

josh_security: Filenames: `/shared/sales-orionbank/kms_rotation_brief.md`, `/shared/sales-orionbank/encryption_summary.txt`, `/shared/sales-orionbank/byok_note.txt`
josh_security: Plain English (Q22/Q23): "Keys are stored in an HSM-backed KMS with automated rotation; data is encrypted in transit with TLS and at rest with disk encryption. Private deployments support customer-managed keys (BYOK)."

nadia_ps: Filenames: `/shared/sales-orionbank/soc2_excerpt.pdf`, `/shared/sales-orionbank/dataflow_narrative.md`, `/shared/sales-orionbank/poc_tenant_filter.png`
nadia_ps: Plain English: "SOC2 controls and the dataflow doc explain access controls and how data moves through the system; the screenshot shows tenant filtering in the runtime dashboard (no PII)."

alex_sales: Two quick asks: 1) ensure all hostnames/account IDs are redacted, 2) add a one-line caption to the screenshot describing what's shown. I'll package and target sending to OrionBank by Wed EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
